scientific_choices.decision: Local paper3.3/Algorithm1: component localization, padding, area filter and cap10; no new network or production change.
Analyze completed GuardedV3 checkpoint chosen by held-out TRAIN bbox Word-F1 and its saved cap10/area0/pad1 TEST OCR; verify actual checkpoint and protocol hashes.

Seed nested maximum geometry matching with exact matches; per-word categories partition all care GT. Separately measure padded-box sensitivity, positive-overlap text matching and one-reading-per-contour padding oracle on baseline contour identities. GT diagnoses only, never selects deployable crops.

Reuse NATIVE128-FAIL-001 coverage.5/fragment.05 bbox proxies and size bins. Validate raw CC count equals external-contour population and retained CC/contour boxes agree before uncapped geometric matching. This is not confirmed uncapped OCR recovery or pixel-mask topology.
CPU-only cached-output analysis, no neural inference, model loading, target changes or GPU allocation; preserve actual upstream GPU/backend metadata.
TEST already explored; V3 below-cap OCR and full TEST probability/pixel masks are absent from saved exports. No independent validation, new crop improvement or strict paper accuracy claimed.
